annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
key_provisions_or_claims: Mandates advanced driver-assistance systems (ISA, AEB, emergency lane-keeping, drowsiness and distraction warning, event data recorders) in new vehicles.
Requires type-approval for automated and fully automated vehicles, with implementing acts on driver replacement systems, driver availability monitoring and data exchange.
Event data recorders must be anonymised, closed-loop and non-deactivatable; driver monitoring data must be deleted immediately.
Incorporates UN Regulations by reference and sets dates for refusing type-approval and registration.
Commission evaluation report due by 7 July 2027 and every five years after.
annotation.summary_en: EU General Safety Regulation 2019/2144 sets type-approval requirements for motor vehicles, mandating advanced driver-assistance systems and event data recorders, protecting vulnerable road users, and establishing a framework for type-approval of automated and fully automated vehicles, with data protection safeguards and UN Regulation incorporation.
annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2019/2144 on type-approval requirements for motor vehicles and their trailers, as regards their general safety and the protection of vehicle occupants and vulnerable road users
